individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows macroscopic ex vivo photographs of lungs (bright field and ICG fluorescence), not a quantitative plot.
Bar chart of ICG mean fluorescence intensity shows individual mouse data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars.

The Cd68 and Spp1 panels are spatial heatmap overlays showing per-spot expression levels; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points. The H&E, ICG and RNAscope images are micrographs, not plots.
GSEA enrichment score curves are line plots, which are exempt from the individual data point requirement.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values derived from differential expression testing (FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test across spots) rather than a mean of discrete biological replicates, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable.
Panel F consists of fluorescence and IHC micrograph images of tissue sections, not a quantitative plot.
